title: Live connection to another dPanel
intro: Link another dPanel with an API token made there. Then take websites or the whole panel from it, or send them to it, without downloading or uploading a backup. Run a sync later to move only the files that changed.
noConnection: Add a connection to see the other panel's websites.
step1: On the other panel open Profile menu → API Tokens.
step2: Make a token with the Live migration scope: Read to take from it, Write to also send to it.
step3: Enter that panel's address and the token here.
token: API token from the other panel
name: Name
thisPanelUrl: This panel's address, for linking from the other side:
makeTokenHere: Make a token on this panel
removeConfirm: Remove the connection to {name}? Delete its token on the other panel too.
noPullScope: This connection's token can't take from the other panel. Make a token with Live migration: Read there.
noPushScope: This connection's token can't send to the other panel. Make a token with Live migration: Write there.
ownerAuto: Same email as on the other panel, else me
manageDns: Create a DNS zone here for new websites
deleteMissing: Sync: also remove files here that the other panel no longer has
manageDnsThere: Create a DNS zone on the other panel for new websites
deleteMissingThere: Sync: also remove files there that this panel no longer has
copyHelp: Copy: files and database; a missing website is created here, an existing one's files and database go to its .trash first. Sync: only files that differ (.gitignore applies); the database is not touched.
copyThereHelp: Copy: files and database; a missing website is created on the other panel, an existing one's files and database go to its .trash first. Sync: only files that differ (.gitignore applies); the database is not touched.
wholePullHelp: The other panel makes a full backup and this panel downloads it. It then appears below in the backup list: restoring it replaces this panel's .env, data and panel database.
wholePushHelp: This panel makes a full backup and sends it. Restore it on the other panel under Migrate → DPanel to DPanel: that replaces its .env, data and panel database.
